subject: Draft: SolarWave case study — technical accuracy & quote review
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: SolarWave case study — technical accuracy & quote review

Hi Aisha —

Attached is the first draft of the case study we discussed (solarwave_case_draft_v1.docx). We focused the narrative on the throughput improvements and bucketed cost reductions after migrating inference to Redwood. Two quick asks:

- Can you confirm the usage numbers in the "Results" section (tokens processed / average latency) are correct and ok to publish?
- Any wording or regulatory constraints we should be aware of before we publish?

If you can send redlines or a short list of edits by EOD Thursday (7/2) that would keep us on track for a July publish.

Thanks again for collaborating on this — excited to tell the story.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: solarwave_case_draft_v1.docx

From: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@solarwave.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@solarwave.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: SolarWave case study — technical accuracy & quote review

Kimberly —

Thanks for sending this over. We skimmed the draft with the engineering and legal teams. A few quick notes:

- The usage figure in the second paragraph says "processed 1.2B tokens in Q1" — engineering has confirmed the raw logs show ~1,198,000,000 tokens but legal prefers we avoid exact values tied to a single quarter. Can we change to "processed over 1B tokens"?
- On latency: the line "median inference latency dropped from 215ms to 64ms" is correct for our internal batch tests, but the customer-facing metric we use is P95; could you instead state P95 went from 320ms to 86ms?
- We need to remove an internal project codename that appears in the Methods section ("Project Mercury"). Please redact that.

I attached a quick annotated PDF with inline comments. Also looping Tom from Legal; he will confirm any contractual constraints on publishing specific metrics.

Best,
Aisha
Head of Platform Engineering | SolarWave Energy
aisha.singh@solarwave.com
Attachment: solarwave_case_draft_v1_comments.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@solarwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: SolarWave case study — technical accuracy & quote review

Aisha —

Appreciate the quick review and clear notes. We'll make the edits you requested: change the token language to "over 1B tokens", swap latency wording to P95, and remove the codename reference.

I've attached v2 (solarwave_case_draft_v2.docx) with those updates plus a highlighted section for the quote we included from your Head of Data. If Tom could weigh in specifically on whether we can publish the quote verbatim, that would be great.

Marissa, would you mind confirming the stats table aligns with our dashboard export?

Thanks —
Kim

Attachment: solarwave_case_draft_v2.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-07-03T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: SolarWave case study — technical accuracy & quote review

Kim / Aisha —

I pulled the export (usage_dashboard_export.csv) and spot-checked the numbers. The v2 table looks correct after the P95 swap. Two small editorial items from our side:

1) For the line about cost reduction, let's change "40% lower token costs" to "~40% lower token costs" to avoid implying precise billing figures.
2) Aisha — can we get a logo release (signed) if we plan to include SolarWave's logo in the PDF? If you're OK, we'll attach a logo and run with the approved imagery.

cc: Laura for any compliance flags.

Thanks,
Marissa
Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@solarwave.com>

Date: 2026-07-03T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: SolarWave case study — technical accuracy & quote review

Kim / Marissa —

Tom (Legal) confirmed: public-facing numbers should be rounded for press materials. We approve the following changes you proposed:

- "over 1B tokens" (instead of 1.2B exact)
- P95 latency wording as supplied
- cost wording to "~40% lower token costs"

Also attached: signed logo release (logo_release_signed.pdf). Tom asked only that we change one short phrase in your customer quote — instead of saying "cut inference costs in half overnight," please change to "reduced inference costs by roughly 50% after migration." Once that small quote tweak is made, Legal signs off.

Thanks for being flexible — we'll look forward to the final PDF.

Aisha
